'''Haronn''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of the [[Corellian Council]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Following the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Haronn was present when the Council aligned itself with the Empire in [[3640 BBY]]. However, he, along with other members of the Council refused to serve the Empire and remained loyal to the Republic. When the Empire [[Battle of Corellia|invaded]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Haronn decided to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with several Republic forces. However, his transport was shot down over Imperial territory in the eastern shipyards. Haronn ejected in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] and was later rescued by a Republic hero.
